response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with a strong track record in mentoring, establishing engineering best practices, and building distributed systems. However, he fundamentally lacks the core technical requirement for this role: 8 years of C++ programming experience. His background primarily focuses on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang in web and application contexts, with less than a year of professional C++ experience, making him unsuitable for a Technical Lead position on a C++ heavy cloud compute platform.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) with a strong focus on distributed systems, microservices, and cloud deployments (Kubernetes, AWS CDK).
Demonstrated commitment to engineering best practices, including TDD, CI/CD, and organizing refactoring dojos and code katas.
Proven technical leadership and mentoring abilities, including organizing workshops, creating courses, and founding an open-source platform.
concerns: Fails to meet the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming experience, possessing less than one year of professional experience with the language.
Experience is heavily skewed towards web, product, and application development rather than core low-level cloud compute infrastructure.
Lacks specific technical leadership experience directly managing or mentoring cloud infrastructure and DevOps engineers.
